scope: Declared before Newton replay: Nominal motion raises only the right little MCP from 1.55 to -0.09 rad over 2.1 s, followed by 1.2 s of feedback settling. Runtime right-thumb feedback follows the current tracked far-material neighborhood, with a 1 rad/s thumb limit and 3 rad/s limit for all per-frame quintics. These geometric checks cover the nominal route; each feedback proposal must also pass runtime joint, finger, palm and material guards. No rope position, velocity, mass or rest length is edited. After feedback ends, the actual terminal joint pose is held for the independent release audit. Helper contact is observed, never constrained. Hold 1.2 s.
